Subject: Re: Hall B4 Pod C — preliminary floorplan + signage slots

Thanks Elena — floorplan looks good and the extra frontage is exactly what we needed. Quick responses below so we can lock things in: 

1) Demo flow (confirmed):
- Entry from west walkway (single-file), two demo stations oriented perpendicular to aisle, exit toward east to avoid cross-traffic.
- We'll use low-profile stanchions + a stripped carpet path. Please request facilities for carpet tape reservation.

2) Signage slots: we will take the two interior-facing slots and two outer-facing slots. Artwork sizes per your spec.

3) Press kits: initial ask is 300 kits as Simon suggested. I'll confirm final content with Marketing.

Tessa / Diego — can you confirm the press kit contents and whether we want an accelerator magnet or a USB? Also we need lanyards for staff (12) + 300 visitor lanyards — lanyard artwork will be similar to the badge insert (see packlist).

Simon / PrintWorks — can you provide:
- Timeline for proofs (PDF proof within 48 hours of final artwork)
- Lead time for banners and press kits (confirm Dec 15 warehouse delivery)
- Ballpark cost estimate for 4 banners + 300 press kits + 300 visitor lanyards

I'll attach a preliminary packlist (presskit_packlist.xlsx) and a banner spec (banner_specs_B4C_v2.pdf) shortly. We need final vendor PO by next Tues (Dec 1) to hit your delivery window.

Best,
Kimberly Park

Subject: Re: Hall B4 Pod C — production timeline and quote

Hi Kimberly team,

Thanks for the details — Simon here from PrintWorks ops. Quick answers: 

- Proofs: We can send a color-corrected PDF proof within 24 hours of receiving final print-ready files. For banners we prefer flattened PDF with crop marks and color profile sRGB or CMYK.
- Lead times: Banners take 5 business days after proof approval; press kits (assembly) take 6 business days after pieces are in-house. If you need Dec 15 warehouse delivery, we need final files and confirmation by end of day Dec 2, and PO by Dec 3 to schedule production.
- Cost estimate (pre-tax, shipping to advance warehouse):
  * 4x retractable banners (33" x 81") — $420 total
  * 300x press kits (folder + single-sheet + USB 8GB) — $1,410 total
  * 300x visitor lanyards (breakaway, single-color) — $360 total
  * Assembly + packaging & palletization — $220
  Estimated total: $2,410

Attachments: proof_template_banner.pdf (for artwork layout) — will upload to your Drive folder.

We can also do a separate run of 50 premium press kits (metal USB + thicker folder) if you want a small press/media tier — add $360. Let us know by Dec 2.

Regards,
Simon Lee
Production Coordinator | PrintWorks Co.
orders@printworks.co
+1 206-555-4001

Kim / team —

Press kit contents (recommended, from Marketing):
- One-pager product overview (single sheet, 8.5x11)
- Pocket folder w/ Redwood Inference logo (color)
- USB (8GB) with consolidated assets (PDFs + product screenshots)
- One 4x6 postcard with quick-start QR code

Counts: 300 visitor kits / 50 press/media premium kits (metal USB).
Lanyards: 12 staff (w/ retractable badge reel) + 300 visitor lanyards (breakaway).

Also recommend adding 300 small removable QR stickers (2" circle) to stick on badge backs — quick scan for product tour. Cost small but high utility.

If PrintWorks can add 300 stickers to the PO we should.

Tessa
